Su-ru ma ton-diM sing-kat ni bo-hiM, Tu ba-ga-san ro-ha-na-mi ma-no-gi-hon ton-di-na-mi, Lao tu sur-go i, tu a-do-pan-Mi.

Sesudah tanda ulang ada birama berisi satu "0" (tanda diam ¼ di paranada) sebelum bagian B → ditulis sebagai ketukan gantung "0 |".
Scan ayat 2–5 (hlm 89) sangat buram/berbintik; beberapa kata dibaca dengan ragu (mis. ayat 5 baris 3 "Mardame manang sonang").
Judul "O Tondi parbadia i, bongoti.", baris pertama lirik "O ulubalang na gogo".

rows: O u-lu-ba-lang na go-go, son-gon sa-da-ri on do Ho ma-naek tu ha-sa-nga-pon!
Naung si-dung do u-la-on-Mi; na ring-kot pa-tu-pa-on-Mi, hu-mop-hop ha-jol-ma-on.
Sa-bam, to-ngan do Ho mu-li tu na u-li mar-ha-bang-sa di-si-a-mun ni Ja-ho-wa.

verses: O ulubalang na gogo, songon sadari on do Ho manaek tu hasangapon!
Naung sidung do ulaonMi; na ringkot patupaonMi, humophop hajolmaon.
Sabam, tongan do Ho muli tu na uli
Marhabangsa disiamun ni Jahowa.
Marloksaloksa Serapim, mamiburju Kerubim
Mamuji Ho na monang dibaen naung pinadomuMi
Saluhut manusia i tu Debata di ginjang.
Puji, Puji. Jesus Kristus naung patulus saluhutna
Timonahon ni AmaNa.
O Jesus, Ho do ulu ni luhutna na porsea i;
Ruasmu anggo hami, Ho hangoluannami on,
Ho hasonangannami on, Ho hagogoonnami!
Suru, togu, rohanami asa hami mangalehon
Tu Ho nasa hasangapon.
Sai taiti rohanami on, urupi hami on tongtong
Mangalo dosanami, paias rohanami be,
Parangenami baen ture, nang pangkataionnami.
Tompa roha, na imbaru, asa haru monang hami
Maralohon dosanami.
Pabulus langkanami be, patigor dalannami pe,
Lao tu banuaginjang. O Jesus, tatap hami on,
Na so tarbaen di tano on, Mardame manang sonang
Sonang, monang, di lambungMu bahenonMu hami sogot,
Dung tu surgo hami bongot.
title: O Tondi parbadia i, bongoti.
status: Lirik dicek · 19/24 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Mar-lok-sa-lok-sa Se-ra-pim, ma-mi-bur-ju Ke-ru-bim Ma-mu-ji Ho na mo-nang di
baen na-ung pi-na-do-mu-Mi Sa-lu-hut ma-nu-si-a i tu De-ba-ta di gin-jang.
Pu-ji, Pu-ji. Je-sus Kris-tus naung pa-tu-lus sa-lu-hut-na Ti-mo-na-hon ni A-ma-Na.
O Je-sus, Ho do u-lu ni lu-hut-na na por-se-a i; Ru-as-mu ang-go ha-mi,
Ho ha-ngo-lu-an-na-mi on, Ho ha-so-na-ngan-na-mi on, Ho ha-go-go-on-na-mi!
Su-ru, to-gu, ro-ha-na-mi a-sa ha-mi ma-nga-le-hon Tu Ho na-sa ha-sa-nga-pon.
Sai tai-ti ro-ha-na-mi on, u-ru-pi ha-mi on tong-tong Ma-nga-lo do-sa-na-mi,
pa-i-as ro-ha-na-mi be, Pa-ra-nge-na-mi baen tu-re, nang pang-ka-tai-on-na-mi.
Tom-pa ro-ha, na im-ba-ru, a-sa ha-ru mo-nang ha-mi Mar-a-lo-hon do-sa-na-mi.
Pa-bu-lus lang-ka-na-mi be, pa-ti-gor da-lan-na-mi pe, Lao tu ba-nu-a-gin-jang.
O Je-sus, ta-tap ha-mi on, Na so tar-baen di ta-no on, Mar-da-me ma-nang so-nang
So-nang, mo-nang, di lam-bung-Mu ba-he-non-Mu ha-mi so-got, Dung tu sur-go ha-mi bo-ngot.

checks: Pembanding lirik: beda ejaan baris 1 ("olopolop"), 5, 16, 18.
"4*" = ♮B di paranada → #4. Pola "3 . 4" dan "4 . 5" bergaris satu+dua dan berlegato = 1/8 bertitik + 1/16 → (3+.+.+#4), (4+.+.+5).
Nama komponis tercetak "Johann Cruger" (ejaan lazim: Crüger).
Judul "Bongoti ma Rohangku.", baris pertama lirik "Mardongan olopolop ma".

rows: Mar-do-ngan o-lop-o-lop ma naek Tu-han-ta i,
Ji-nang-kon ni na to-rop su-ru-su-ru-an i.
An-tong nang hi-ta pe, ta-pu-ji ma Tu-han-ta. mar-en-de-en-de hi-ta, mar-o-lop-o-lop be.

verses: Mardongan olopolop ma naek Tuhanta i,
Jinangkon ni na torop surusuruan i.
Antong nang hita pe, tapuji ma Tuhanta.
Marendeende hita, marolopolop be.
Na mulak do Tuhanta tu habangsaNa i,
Tu lambung ni AmaNa di siamunNa i.
Disomba sasude na di banuaginjang
Tuhanta i na monang, ro sian tano i.
Tatimbang ma lapangna umbaen na songon i;
Ai naeng ma dohot hita tumopot surgo i.
Antong, taingot ma: ianggo Tuhan Jesus,
Ibana do patulus, nidok ni Debata.
Ditaon do hamatean, humophop hita on,
Pature pardalanan na sian tano on,
Manogu hita be tu lambung ni AmaNa;
Disi, di adopanNa naeng sahat sasude.
I pe ringgas ma hita mangalo dosa i,
Manggotap roha daging, nang hajahaton pe.
Tahalungunhon be Tuhanta na di ginjang;
Ibana do na monang, i ma tatiru be.
O Jesus, Tuhannami asi ma rohaMi,
Sai sesa dosanami, palua hami be.
Pamasuk hami on tu hangoluan sogot,
Sai loas hami dohot mamuji Ho tongtong.
title: Bongoti ma Rohangku.
status: Lirik dicek · 20/24 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Na mu-lak do Tu-han-ta tu ha-bang-sa-Na i,
Tu lam-bung ni A-ma-Na di si-a-mun-Na i.
Di-som-ba sa-su-de na di ba-nu-a-gin-jang Tu-han-ta i na mo-nang, ro si-an ta-no i.
Ta-tim-bang ma la-pang-na um-baen na so-ngon i;
Ai naeng ma do-hot hi-ta tu-mo-pot sur-go i.
An-tong, ta-i-ngot ma: i-ang-go Tu-han Je-sus, I-ba-na do pa-tu-lus, ni-dok ni De-ba-ta.
Di-taon do ha-ma-te-an, hu-mop-hop hi-ta on,
Pa-tu-re par-da-la-nan na si-an ta-no on,
Ma-no-gu hi-ta be tu lam-bung ni A-ma-Na; Di-si, di a-do-pan-Na naeng sa-hat sa-su-de.
I pe ring-gas ma hi-ta ma-nga-lo do-sa i,
Mang-go-tap ro-ha da-ging, nang ha-ja-ha-ton pe.
Ta-ha-lu-ngun-hon be Tu-han-ta na di gin-jang; I-ba-na do na mo-nang, i ma ta-ti-ru be.
O Je-sus, Tu-han-na-mi a-si ma ro-ha-Mi,
Sai se-sa do-sa-na-mi, pa-lu-a ha-mi be.
Pa-ma-suk ha-mi on tu ha-ngo-lu-an so-got, Sai lo-as ha-mi do-hot ma-mu-ji Ho tong-tong.
